senses.zh_definition: Megsie：有文献记录的人名昵称形式；苏格兰语词典将其列为 Margaret 的昵称之一。输入中的具体指称尚未确定，不能据此赋予马来语普通词义。
senses.en_definition: An attested personal nickname, recorded in Scots among familiar forms of Margaret; the referent of the supplied token is unresolved.
senses.ms_definition: Nama panggilan yang direkodkan dalam bahasa Scots sebagai salah satu bentuk mesra bagi Margaret; rujukan khusus dalam input belum dikenal pasti.
senses.nuances: 本条为专名候选的编辑说明，不是 DBP 官方释义，因此不标记为 official。词性 noun 在此涵盖专有名词。昵称用法见 [Dictionaries of the Scots Language](https://dsl.ac.uk/entry/snd/meg)。下列搭配及情景为编写的教学例句，不代表已验证的高频搭配；排名仅沿用输入。

etymology.historical_story: Megsie has a documented naming history outside Malay. The Scottish National Dictionary records it among affectionate forms associated with Margaret, alongside other familiar variants. This establishes a nickname use, but does not identify the person behind this corpus token or establish a Malay borrowing. Its occurrence should therefore remain separate from verified Malay vocabulary. [Source](https://dsl.ac.uk/entry/snd/meg).
